g.text: LRR: log2 of the bin's median depth over the member's autosomal median (GC-corrected where a GC
track was given)
the step fit of the track (total-variation denoising): a piecewise-constant reading in which every jump has
to earn its height

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: BAF: the alt-allele fraction at the member's heterozygous sites (a sample of them)

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: an informative site whose alt allele came from the mother (father 0/0, mother 1/1)

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: an informative site whose alt allele came from the father (father 1/1, mother 0/0)
the phased fraction at one heterozygous site: of the maternal allele (the child), of the allele passed to the
child (a parent); reference bias out
the phased fraction pooled over a window of sites (depth-weighted): at 1/2 where the homologues are
equal, 1/2 + d or 1/2 - d along an event, the sign the parent of origin - in the child, below one half the
paternal homologue is in excess (a paternal gain, a maternal copy lost), above one half the maternal; in a
parent, below one half the event lies on the homologue not passed to the child, above one half on the one
passed; hollow where the window is parted in two or more members (paralogy), which the fits and the
scan leave out
the child's maternal fraction read at the sites where the father is homozygous and the mother
heterozygous: it leaves the main track where the child carries two different maternal homologues (a
meiotic maternal trisomy or heterodisomy) and returns where a crossover made them one
the same at the sites where the mother is homozygous and the father heterozygous: it leaves the main
track where the child carries two different paternal homologues
a parent's transmitted-allele fraction read at the sites where the child is heterozygous and the other parent
homozygous: it leaves the main track where the child carries two different homologues of this parent

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: the child's maternal copies: the LRR step fit's copies (2 x 2^LRR) times the maternal fraction's step fit

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: the child's paternal copies, the same way

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: a parent's copies of the homologue passed to the child, the same way

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: a parent's copies of the other homologue

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: a called gain (line at the segment's mean LRR)

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: a called loss

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: a called copy-neutral event - a loss of heterozygosity, or a uniparental heterodisomy (drawn at zero)

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: an event given from elsewhere (--events), drawn above the track

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: reference lines: zero LRR, BAF at 1/2, 1/3 and 2/3; the centromere
